'''Kelleran Beq''', nicknamed the "'''Sabered Hand'''," was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi Master]] who served in the [[Jedi Order]]. He was often assisted by the [[protocol droid]] [[AD-3]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[LX-R5]], and served aboard the [[starship]] ''[[Athylia]].'' In [[22 BBY]], Master Beq worked in the [[Jedi crèche]], tending to the younglings of the temple. During [[Operation: Knightfall]], Beq successfully escaped the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] with the aid of sympathetic [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] members, fleeing [[Coruscant]] with the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]].

==Biography==
===Training Jedi===
{{Quote|By the right of the Council, by the will of the Force, you are now Jedi Knights.|Kelleran Beq|<ref name="swgoh">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>}}
[[File:KelleranBeqAthylia-AhmedBestIG.png|thumb|250px|left|Kelleran Beq at the helm of the ''Athylia'']]
Kelleran Beq was a [[Jedi Master]] who supervised [[Padawan]]s as they went through their [[Jedi Trials]]. He was assisted by the [[protocol droid]] [[AD-3]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[LX-R5]].<ref name="Episode 1">{{JTC|1}}</ref> Beq had served aboard the [[starship]] ''[[Athylia]]''.<ref name="Kelleran Beq" /> The Jedi Master had fond memories of his Jedi Trials and earned the nickname the "Sabered Hand" during his time as a [[Padawan]].<ref name="Episode 5">{{JTC|5}}</ref> Beq was also considered a [[Jedi Vanguard]].<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>

Directly after the [[Anakin Skywalker's Knighting Ceremony|knighting ceremony]] that took place after the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] instructed the newly knighted Jedi [[Thirteenth Sister|Iskat Akaris]] to guide the younglings back to the crèche, where they were receiving training from Beq. Upon their arrival at the crèche however, they found that Beq had still yet to arrive, thereby leading Akaris to lead their training for a certain amount of time until Beq finally arrived to take over from Akaris.<ref name="Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref>

===Great Jedi Purge===
[[File:Kelleran_Beq_speeder_bike_chase.png|right|thumb|250px|Kelleran Beq helps Grogu escape from the Jedi Temple during the Great Jedi Purge.]]
During [[Operation: Knightfall]] of the [[Great Jedi Purge]], Beq waited for the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]],<ref name="Chapter 20" /> who was one of his students,<ref name="SW Interview" /> to arrive in an [[Turbolift|elevator]]. As the elevator door opened, Beq with [[Kelleran Beq's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] already ignited told Grogu that he was there to save the youngling. Beq picked up another [[lightsaber]] from another fallen Jedi and used it to his advantage as he protected Grogu. They were quickly ambushed by several [[clone trooper]]s of the [[501st Legion]] but the Jedi Master managed to deflect the oncoming blaster fire and [[Force push]]ed a clone trooper off the edge of the temple. As more reinforcements arrived, Beq and Grogu rushed to a [[BARC speeder]] and fled the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Chapter 20" />

While in the skies of [[Coruscant]], Beq and Grogu were chased by several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Republic LAAT/i gunships]]. Beq warned Grogu that it was going to be rough after one of the the gunships managed to hit the [[engine]] of the [[speeder]]. Trying to flee the gunships, Beq flew inside a [[hovertrain]] tunnel, though a hovertrain soon approached the two going from the opposite direction of the tunnel. Beq made a turn to avoid collision while the train crashed into a pursuing gunship and flew into a [[Train station|station]] which led to [[Monument Plaza]]. As they continued to fly off, Beq told Grogu to not worry and that they were going to meet some of his friends before adding that it was going to be a bumpy landing. They reached the platform, but Beq fell off the speeder as they landed. The Jedi Master then got back up and opened the [[Hover pram|hovering pram]] to check if Grogu was alright.<ref name="Chapter 20" />

[[File:Kelleran_Beq_and_Grogu_entering_hyperspace.png|left|thumb|250px|Kelleran Beq and Grogu jump into hyperspace as they flee from Coruscant.]]
Beq was then greeted by the sympathetic [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] aboard the ''[[Heyblibber Duck]]'', an [[H-type Nubian yacht]] used by [[Gungan]] [[representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], who worked with Beq long ago.<ref name="Jar Jar 1>[[Jar Jar 1|''Jar Jar'' 1]]</ref> One of the guards asked about the other Jedi to which Beq responded there were no others left. Their conversation was cut short as a gunship landed on the platform and both clone troopers and [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock troopers]] started to move out and shoot. The guard told Beq to take the ship and that it was fueled and ready to go, while the guards of the Royal Naboo Security Forces bought some time for their escape. Beq and Grogu entered the [[yacht]] and the Jedi Master quickly started the ship. Two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] soon approached them from the sky and started to shoot as Beq took off from the platform. As they left Coruscant and entered [[Realspace|space]], Beq immediately jumped into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Chapter 20" />

==Personality and traits==
Kelleran Beq was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with dark skin and [[Color|black]] hair.<ref name="Episode 1" /> According to AD-3, Beq was "halfway through his lifespan."<ref name="Episode 3">{{JTC|3}}</ref> While Beq was on friendly terms with his servant droid AD-3, the latter was envious of his [[The Force|Force]] powers since she lacked them as a droid.<ref name="SW Show 27 May 2020">{{StarWarsShow|fKdMtEiHGnM|Ahmed Best and Mary Holland Talk Jedi Temple Challenge, And We Celebrate The Empire Strikes Back!|sw_url=video/ahmed-best-and-mary-holland-talk-jedi-temple-challenge-and-we-celebrate-the-empire-strikes-back}}</ref> AD-3 repeatedly teased Beq about him using his Force powers to close doors and lift rocks.<ref name="Episode 4">{{JTC|4}}</ref><ref name="Episode 6">{{JTC|6}}</ref> Beq was devoted to his student Grogu and his survival.<ref name="SW Interview" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:KelleranBeq-SWCT.png|thumb|right|200px|Jedi Master Kelleran Beq wielded a green lightsaber.]]
Beq was a highly skilled Jedi<ref name="Databank" /> Master.<ref name="Episode 1" /> His skills with [[lightsaber]]s earned him the nickname "Sabered Hand."<ref name="Episode 5">{{JTC|5}}</ref> Beq had the habit of reminding AD-3 about his nickname, much to her annoyance.<ref name="Episode 6" /> Beq was proficient at [[Jar'Kai]], being able to wield two lightsabers at once, notably doing so during the [[Operation: Knightfall|siege of the Jedi Temple]] to kill the Clone Troopers coming after him and the youngling he defended.<ref name="Chapter 20" />

As a Jedi, Beq was able to use [[the Force]], which he used to [[Telekinesis|levitate]] rocks.<ref name="Episode 1" /> He also used the Force to [[Force push|fling]] a clone trooper off a ledge while protecting Grogu.<ref name="Chapter 20" /> Beq could also communicate with the Force.<ref name="Episode 7">{{JTC|7}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Kelleran Beq [[Kelleran Beq's lightsaber|owned]] a [[Color|green]]-bladed [[lightsaber]], which he used to defend himself and Grogu against the [[Clone trooper]]s of the [[501st Legion]].<ref name="Chapter 20" />

==Behind the scenes==
===''Jedi Temple Challenge''===
{{Quote|I think what's the most important about the representation of someone like Kelleran Beq as far as being a person of color and the leader of this Temple—kind of like the Dean of Jedi—is it breaks down what's possible. It breaks down what you can do, and creates just a brand new world of possibilities out there.|Ahmed Best describing his character Kelleran Beq|<ref name="Step Inside">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-jedi-temple-challenge-interviews|text=Step Inside ''Star Wars: Jedi Temple Challenge''}}</ref>}}
[[File:KelleranBeq-ABig.png|left|thumb|270px|Kelleran Beq in ''Jedi Temple Challenge''.]]
Kelleran Beq is a character created for ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Temple Challenge]].'' He is portrayed by [[Ahmed Best]], who also portrayed [[Jar Jar Binks]]. In an interview with [[Anthony Carboni]] on ''[[The Star Wars Show]]'', Best stated that the showrunners [[Steve Blank]] and [[Scott Bromley]], and executive producers [[Christine Beebe]] and [[Mickey Capoferri]], had given him considerable flexibility in developing Kelleran Beq's histories, mannerisms, and even lightsaber color. Best confirmed that Beq was related to [[Achk Med-Beq]], whom he had portrayed in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], though no [[canon]]ical source has confirmed the relation.<ref name="Kelleran Beq" />

Best also revealed his character's nickname of the "Sabered Hand" ahead of its mention in the series,<ref name="Twitter 1">{{Twitter|ahmedbest|status/1268211528219664385|[[Ahmed Best]]|quote=I'm so pumped to share #jeditemplechallenge with everyone. The fan response at Celebration last year was the beginning of my return to the galaxy I love so much. #KelleranBeq "The Sabered Hand" is the first Black...|archivefile=File:Kelleran Beq nickname.png}}</ref> though this would be referred to in-universe with "the" uncapitalised.<ref name="swgoh" /> During an interview with [[Kristin Baver]], Best confirmed that Beq's purple lightsaber color was an intended homage to Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]].<ref name="Step Inside" /> Upon appearing in ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} "[[Chapter 20: The Foundling]]," however, [[Kelleran Beq's lightsaber|Beq's lightsaber]] sported a green blade.<ref name="Chapter 20" /> He also stated that other aspects of Beq's character were inspired by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Yoda]], and the [[Wikipedia:Shaolin Kung Fu|Shaolin monks]] from Best's childhood favorite kung fu movies. Best described Beq as the first Jedi dedicated to teaching, adding that he had been inspired by Kenobi and Yoda's nurturing kind of mentorship.<ref name="Step Inside" />

Best posted on Twitter that the pieces of Beq's lightsaber are pieces that are available to everyone at [[Savi's Workshop]] and said that his philosophy when it comes to teaching is that all types of learning should be accessible to everyone, even lightsaber learning. Best has said that at Kelleran Beq's core he is a teacher and that part of the rationale behind this was his desire for Beq to be relatable to the audience rather than apart from them.<ref name="GLTS">{{YouTube|video=qhlPLJ1IsKY|text=Episode XI "Best in Show" with Ahmed Best|channel=UCH1XwfxXB|name=The George Lucas Talk Show}}</ref>

===The return in ''The Mandalorian''===
{{Quote|I mean, I was excited. I don't think people really understand how much I care about Star Wars. Like, I really care. I really, really care about the storytelling, about the mythology, about the fans. I really want Star Wars to deliver, and if I become an obstacle to that, then I shouldn't be in it. I don't want to be bigger than the story. I don't want to be bigger than the mythology. I want to contribute, I want to add to it. So it took me a minute.|Ahmed Best on Kelleran Beq's return|<ref name="SW Interview" />}}
[[File:Kelleran_Beq_MandoS3.png|thumb|250px|Kelleran Beq's updated look in ''The Mandalorian''.]]
An interview with the [[StarWars.com]] Team revealed that Best took some consideration when he was asked to reprise his role as the Jedi Master because of his harsh past with the franchise. Best stated that he was excited, but it was not something that he could immediately give an answer to. However, the support by the show's creators [[Jon Favreau]] and [[Dave Filoni]] convinced him to come back.<ref name="SW Interview" />

Similarly, just like on ''Jedi Temple Challenge'', Best was a creative partner in developing Kelleran Beq for ''The Mandalorian''. He worked closely with costume designer [[Shawna Trpcic]], they incorporated elements such as Best's tribal tattoos and Afrofuturist symbols into the outfit's gold detailing. In addition, Best developed his own view and understanding on what the [[The Force|Force]] is for Kelleran Beq, and also developed a unique fighting technique inspired by [[Wikipedia:Bruce Lee|Bruce Lee]] and "the style of the unknown." Building on the backstory he had created for Kelleran Beq in ''Jedi Temple Challenge'', Best viewed the Jedi Master as a celebration of teaching.<ref name="SW Interview" /> Beq secured a fan-favorite status<ref name="Marvel8">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/122259/star_wars_jedi_knights_2025_8|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knights (2025) #8}}</ref> since his appearances in ''The Mandalorian'' and ''Jedi Temple Challenge''.<ref name="SW Interview" />

The reference to Beq<ref name="Tom Kelleran and Noxi">{{Twitter|DarthInternous|status/1695871618193510828|[[Tom Hoeler]]|date=2023-08-27|quote=The ref was seeing Kelleran Beq on Mando, and being able to layer him in as a presence in the Jedi Temple. The cameo character with a speaking role is Noxi Kell, originally from Brotherhood. Who is a delight.|archivedate=20230827185420}}</ref> in the 2023 novel ''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' by [[Delilah S. Dawson]]<ref name="Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade" /> was added very late into the book's production<ref name="Tom Twitter tidbit 2">{{Twitter|DarthInternous|status/1678475122670182413|[[Tom Hoeler]]|date=2023-07-10|quote=One particular reference was a really fun "last minute" addition that involved us rushing back through the manuscript to layer something in. Its particularly fun when we get to "react" to stuff and do that.|archivedate=20230717231657}}</ref> after his appearance in ''The Mandalorian''. According to editor [[Tom Hoeler]], the reference helps to layer Beq into life at the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Tom Kelleran and Noxi" /> Hoeler stated that the reference was added via the team "rushing back through the manuscript" in order to find a place for it.<ref name="Tom Twitter tidbit 2" /> Kelleran Beq was also introduced as a playable character of the same name in the 2015 mobile game ''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes'' in 2023, which features characters and ships from both the canon and Legends continuities.<ref name="EA-Kit Reveal - Kelleran Beq">{{EA|url=games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/kit-reveal-kelleran-beq|text=Kit Reveal - Kelleran Beq}}</ref>

===The world of comics===
{{Quote|I have been speechless about this since I was told about it, but to actually see #kelleranbeq in the pages of @marvel comics has been overwhelming. I have been a huge #marvelcomics fan for decades. My love of reading and learning and making movies started in the pages of @marvel. If the young comic nerd that I was, could imagine a character that he created would be beloved in the lore of his favorite movies, he would be so proud. I am so grateful that @Starwars and @marvel have embraced #jedi #master #kelleranbeq.|Ahmed Best discusses Kelleran Beq appearing in comics via Instagram|<ref name="BestJK1">{{Instagram|username=bestahmed|url=p/DG1NjSuSA-w|name=Ahmed Best|date=2025-03-05|quote=I have been speechless about this since I was told about it, but to actually see #kelleranbeq in the pages of @marvel comics has been overwhelming. I have been a huge #marvelcomics fan for decades. My love of reading and learning and making movies started in the pages of @marvel. If the young comic nerd that I was, could imagine a character that he created would be beloved in the lore of his favorite movies, he would be so proud. I am so grateful that @Starwars and @marvel have embraced #jedi #master #kelleranbeq. This is just the beginning for #thesaberedhand and in the words of one of my hero’s, #EXCELSIOR. #STAR WARS: JEDI KNIGHTS #1 by Marc Guggenheim and Madibek Musabekov! This new Marvel Comics series tells all-new adventures of the Jedi who were active during the Prequel era and Kelleran will be spotlighted in an upcoming issue! #themandalorian #grogu #jarjarbinks|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/IeJRo}}</ref>}}
[[File:AhmedBestJK8-Insta.png|thumb|left|250px|Ahmed Best celebrates the release of ''Jedi Knights'' 8 and its inclusion of Kelleran Beq.]]
Kelleran Beq made his comic debut within a Force vision in the [[Jedi Knights 1|first issue]] of the ongoing series ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knights]]'',<ref name="Jedi Knights 1">[[Jedi Knights 1|''Jedi Knights'' 1]]</ref> which was written by [[Marc Guggenheim]], illustrated by [[Madibek Musabekov]], and released on [[March 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="Marvel1">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/122252/star_wars_jedi_knights_2025_1|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knights (2025) #1}}</ref> Best was told about Beq's brief appearance ahead of release and became overjoyed upon learning his character would be featured in [[Marvel Comics]]. He also learned and promised fans Beq would receive a spotlight in the future issue of the series,<ref name="BestJK1" /> which came to pass in [[Jedi Knights 8|''Jedi Knights'' 8]]<ref name="Jedi Knights 8">[[Jedi Knights 8|''Jedi Knights'' 8]]</ref> on [[October 22]] of that year. Written by Guggenheim and Musabekov once again, Beq's appearance in the comic was marketed as a major selling point, advertising him as a guest-star.<ref name="Marvel8" /> Best celebrated the issue's release by traveling to his local comic shop and purchasing multiple copies of the issue, collecting the various variant covers in the process. Best was overjoyed by Beq's appearance in a comic story and, in an Instagram post, thanked the many ''Star Wars'' fans who had supported him over the years.<ref name="BestJK8">{{Instagram|username=bestahmed|url=p/DQIfXleD7dP|name=Ahmed Best|date=2025-10-22|quote=Out Today, issue 8 of#marvel #starwars #jediknights comic.  When I was a kid, new titles day at the local comic shop was the highlight of my week. That feeling came back HUGE today when I saw #kelleranbeq on the shelf of my local comic shop.  I’m so happy, today. Thank you to all the #starwars fans that have held me in your thoughts. It’s truly an honor to be a part of the fandom and of the #galaxy. This is just the beginning, #jarjar written by me and @marcguggenheim drops February.  I’m so excited for everyone to read it. You, the audience, have so much power. THe more you support the more we get to do.  I promise, I see you, I hear you and now I can be a voice for you in comics and beyond (fingers crossed.) #maytheforcebewithyou.|archivefile=File:AhmedBest-JediKnights8ComicShop-IG.png}}</ref>

Best himself took up the challenge of writing Beq, joining Guggenheim in penning the story [[Jar Jar 1|''Jar Jar'' 1]], which features both Binks and Beq.<ref name="Reveal">{{SW|url=news/nycc-2025-lucasfilm-publishing-reveals|text=NYCC 2025: All the News and Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> Featuring art by [[Kieran McKeown]],<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|skytalkerspod|status/1977041899979456936|name=Skytalkers|quote=COMING SOON: Jar Jar comic!!! Cowriting with Ahmed Best that also features Kelleran Beq!!!!!! Levels of meta!|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/dmyQ0}}</ref> the comic was announced at New York Comic Con 2025 and released in the [[February]] of [[2026]].<ref name="Reveal" /> Best held onto the news for a long period of time and was very happy when he was finally about to discuss his Marvel writing debut, promising that the story would see Beq and Binks on an adventure that would ripple through the ''Star Wars'' canon.<ref name="BestJJ1">{{Instagram|username=bestahmed|url=p/DPraJxzDw8I|name=Ahmed Best|date=2025-10-11|quote=Been holding on to this news for what feels like forever and now I can finally announce my debut as a WRITER FOR @MARVEL COMICS! I get to write a team up comic for both my @starwars Characters #kelleranbeq and #jarjarbinks. JAR JAR issue 1 drops in February 2026. @marcguggenheim and I are writing a story that makes the #jedimasterkelleranbeq #jarjarbinks team up have a ripple affect that will be felt through all the #starwars timelines. I am honestly fighting the tears right now. I was raised by #marvel and on #marvelcomics. It’s why I do what i do. Those books were and still are my happy place in a challenging world. 12 year old Ahmed is so proud right now. Thank you #lucasfilm for always being in my corner and letting express my art through this galaxy that we love. I will always be a fan first, but being a writer for #marvel comics makes me feel like I truly made it. #wearejarjar #theprequels #writer #director #actor #artist #futurist #skinnykidfromthebronx.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/9EFdM}}</ref> Best was very excited for the fandom to read the story and promised that, with support from the fans, his characters would continue to appear. Further, he hoped he could use comics and other mediums to act as a voice for fans who did not feel heard.<ref name="BestJK8" />
